steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: All goblins should wear red armour!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Not red! Red armour make you look fat.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Everything make YOU look fat!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Fatty!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: SHUT UP!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Even this human think you look fat! Don't you, human?

steps.player: Um...
Yes, he looks fat!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Ha ha! See, fatty? Even human think you fat!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Me not care what human think! Human ugly!

options.text: Why are you arguing about the colour of your armour?

steps.player: Why are you arguing about the colour of your armour?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: We decide to celebrate goblin new century by changing colour of our armour. Brown get boring after a bit. We want change.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Problem is, we can't agree on new colour. We think maybe we use old goblin tribe colours, but Bentnoze from rubbish Thorobshuun tribe and me from much better Garagorshuun tribe.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Thorobshuun tribe colour is red! Way better than silly green of Garagorshuun tribe.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up!

options.text: What is the goblin new century?

steps.player: What is the goblin new century?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Goblin century mark year of battle on Plain of Mud. That when Big High War God give goblin commandments.

steps.player: Big High War God?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Big High War God is god for goblins. He take us and make us strong, not stupid like humans.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Me bet Big High War God would pick red armour.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up! Big High War God would hate you!

steps.player: Wouldn't you prefer peace?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Goblins not so good at peace. Maybe peace be okay though, as long as it peace wearing green armour.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: But green too much like skin. Nearly make you look naked!

options.text: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

steps.player: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Yes, as long as you pick green.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: No you have to pick red!

steps.player: You should wear red.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: See? Even stupid human think red best. Now we all wear red!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Human not know anything! If we wear red then whole village be ugly like YOU!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Go away human. You not helping.

steps.player: You should wear green.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Green! We all wear green now, human has decided!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Why we have to do what human say? He not boss of us!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: No but he agree with me!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: That prove you a filthy human-lover!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Me hate humans! This human just happen to be right!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Go away human. You not know anything.

steps.player: What about a different colour?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: That would mean me wrong... but at least Wartface not right!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Well Bentnoze never been right in his life. Still, maybe new colour good, but will have to see armour before decide.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Human! You bring us armour in new colour!

steps.player: I can do that.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: What colour we try?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Orange armour might be good.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Yep, bring us orange armour.

steps.player: How am I meant to get orange armour?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Well first you get goblin armour...

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: ...and then you dye it orange!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Even human should be able to work that out!

options.text: Where do I get goblin armour?

steps.player: Where do I get goblin armour?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: There some spare armour around village somewhere. You can take that.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: It in crates somewhere. Can't remember which crates now.

steps.player: Where do I get dye?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: You go north of here into wilderness. There you find many ways to die!

steps.player: No, D-Y-E, not D-I-E.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Stupid Bentnoze, you not know how to spell!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up Wartface!

steps.player: Do you know where I can get dye?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Me not know where dye come from.

steps.player: Well where did you get your red and green dye from?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Some goblin or other, he steal it. Say he steal it from old witch in Draynor Village.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Maybe you can get more dye from her?

steps.player: Okay, I'll be back soon.
Actually, I think I'll leave you to it.
I'll leave you to it.

options.text: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

steps.player: No, he doesn't look fat.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Shut up human! Wartface fat and human stupid!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up Bentnoze!

options.text: Why are you arguing about the colour of your armour?
Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: I tell all goblins in village to wear green armour now!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: They not listen to you! I already tell them wear red armour!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: They listen to me not you! They know me bigger general!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Me bigger general! They listen to me!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Human! What colour armour they wearing out there?

steps.player: Half of them are wearing red and half of them green.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up human! They wearing green armour really! Human lying because he scared of you!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Human scared of me not you? Then you think me bigger general!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: What? Me mean...

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Shut up! Me bigger general!

options.text: Why are you arguing about the colour of your armour?
Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: We should wear green armour!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Green armour? Are you stupid?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: You stupid! Only stupid goblins think red armour better!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: No they don't! Me think red armour better!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: That because you stupid!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Me not stupid!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Then why you not like green armour?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Because red armour better!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Only stupid goblins think that! You stupid!

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Green armour best.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: No no red every time.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Go away human, we busy.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Red armour best.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: No it has to be green!

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Go away human, we busy.

options.text: Why are you arguing about the colour of your armour?
Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?

starting-off-talking-to-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
starting-off-talking-to-grubfoot.text: Grubfoot wear red armour! Grubfoot wear green armour!

starting-off-talking-to-grubfoot.speaker: Grubfoot
starting-off-talking-to-grubfoot.text: Why they not make up their minds?

steps.player: Why is red best?

steps.speaker: Goblin
steps.text: Cos General Bentnoze says so, and he bigger than me.

steps.player: Err, okay.

talking-to-the-goblins-in-the-village-di.speaker: Goblin
talking-to-the-goblins-in-the-village-di.text: He wearing [red/green] armour! [General Wartface/General Bentnoze] tell us wear [green/red]!

talking-to-the-goblins-in-the-village-di.speaker: Goblin
talking-to-the-goblins-in-the-village-di.text: But [General Bentnoze/General Wartface] say we must wear [red/green]!

searching-crates-with-goblin-armour.text: You find some goblin mail in the crate.

searching-crates-with-goblin-armour-sear.text: You search the crate, but but find nothing of interest.

steps.player: What do you think of this colour?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: That wrong colour.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: We tell you get orange armour.

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: If the player uses orange dye on the goblin mail:

steps.text: You dye the goblin mail orange.
orange goblin mail

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: If the player uses orange-painted goblin armour on one of the generals:

steps.player: I have some orange armour here.

steps.text: A cutscene begins with the Generals fetching Grubfoot...

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Grubfoot!

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: Yes General Wartface?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Put on this armour!
Grubfoot goes into the changing room with orange-painted goblin mail.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: No I don't like that much.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: It clashes with skin colour.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: We need darker colour, like blue.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Yeah blue might be good.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Human! Get us blue armour!
The cutscene ends.

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.speaker: Grubfoot
showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: Me not like this orange armour. Make me look like that thing.

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.speaker: Grubfoot
showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: That fruit thing. The one that orange. What it called?

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.speaker: Grubfoot
showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: That right. This armour make me look same colour as orange-fruit.

steps.player: What do you think of this colour?

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: If the player uses blue-painted goblin armour on one of the generals:

steps.text: Put on this armour!
Grubfoot goes into the changing room, switching his orange armour to blue armour.

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: That not right. Not goblin colour at all.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Goblins wear dark earthy colours like brown.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: Yeah brown might be good.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Human! Get us brown armour!

steps.player: But I thought brown was the armour you were changing from...
Never mind, anything is worth a try.

steps.text: The cutscene ends.

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.speaker: Grubfoot
showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: Me not like this blue colour.

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.speaker: Grubfoot
showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: Me not know. It just make me feel...

showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.speaker: Grubfoot
showing-the-generals-different-goblin-ar.text: Makes me feel kind of sad.

steps.text: Put on this armour!

steps.speaker: Grubfoot
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: That colour quite nice. Me can see myself wearing that.

steps.speaker: General Bentnoze
steps.text: It a deal then. Brown armour it is.

steps.speaker: General Wartface
steps.text: Thank you for sorting out argument, human. You have reward now.

steps.player: Thanks... I think...
